{{short description|Italian mathematician}}
'''Gaspare Mainardi''' (June 1800 in [[Abbiategrasso]], [[Province of Milan|Milan]] – 9 March 1879 in [[Lecco]]) was an Italian [[mathematician]] active in [[differential geometry]]. He is remembered for the [[Gauss–Codazzi equations|Gauss–Codazzi–Mainardi]] equations.
